title: Clean good packs keep their text across the lookup eval set
goal: TestRoute runs every lookup_eval.csv row expected good: each clean good pack prints no route, kb has or kb lacks line, each flagged one prints `route: split`, and every good pack routed split has a check: line or a word nowhere in the kb, so a rule that demotes clean goods fails the test; no fixture of whole pack texts, which kb content changes would break.
notes: The eval check passes now: it guards the verdicts, which this task must not move. Research agents add kb content while the sprint runs, so the test reads the eval set on HEAD rather than a stored pack text.
